description: This PHP file defines the class `JsonFileCalendarProvider`, which extends `AbstractCalendarProvider` and provides functionality to interact with calendar events stored as JSON files. It includes methods to test the connection, load, save, create, retrieve, update, and delete calendar events, as well as to map JSON data to domain-specific objects.

classes.name: JsonFileCalendarProvider
classes.description: A class providing calendar event operations via JSON file storage, including connection testing, event CRUD operations, and data mapping.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests if the provider can access and write to the JSON file storing calendar data.

methods.name: initializeFilePath
methods.description: Initializes the file path based on the connection and user ID, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: loadEvents
methods.description: Loads events from the JSON file into memory, handling file existence, reading, and JSON parsing.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events matching the provided query filters.

methods.name: mapToCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Maps JSON event data to a CalendarAccountEvent object.

methods.name: matchesQuery
methods.description: Checks if a calendar event matches the start and end date filters from the query.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event by adding it to the JSON file storage.

methods.name: mapFromCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into an array suitable for JSON encoding.

methods.name: saveEvents
methods.description: Saves the current events array to the JSON file.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a single event by ID from the JSON storage.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in the JSON file.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from the JSON storage by ID.
